title: Amazon gives OpenAI's ad business a boost, letting its advertisers into ChatGPT
summary: Amazon has recently made a significant move by allowing its advertisers to access OpenAI's ChatGPT platform, marking a shift in its previously cautious approach towards external AI integrations. This decision is expected to enhance the advertising capabilities of Amazon's webstore, providing advertisers with innovative tools to engage with customers. By embracing this partnership, Amazon aims to leverage the advanced AI technology of OpenAI to boost its ad business and improve user experience.
shadowing: Amazon has been hesitant to open its sprawling webstore.
This decision marks a shift in its approach towards AI.
Advertisers can now access OpenAI's ChatGPT platform.
The partnership aims to enhance advertising capabilities.
Amazon seeks to improve user experience through AI technology.
